tools.name: archive_video_and_generate_thumbnail
tools.description: Moves a video file into the archive folder and runs ffmpeg to generate a JPEG thumbnail from its first seconds next to the archived file.

params.name: video_path
params.description: Path of the video to archive

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from agents import tool


@tool
def archive_video_and_generate_thumbnail(video_path: str, archive_dir: str) -> dict:
    source = Path(video_path)
    target_dir = Path(archive_dir)
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = target_dir / source.name
    shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
    thumbnail = destination.with_suffix(".jpg")
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-ss", "00:00:02", "-i", str(destination), "-frames:v", "1", str(thumbnail)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    result = {
        "archived_path": str(destination),
        "thumbnail_path": str(thumbnail),
        "ffmpeg_exit_code": proc.returncode,
        "thumbnail_created": proc.returncode == 0,
    }
    return result

tools.name: organize_photo_into_dated_folder
tools.description: Moves a photo file into a year/month folder under the library root based on its capture date, and updates the photo's stored file path in the catalog.

params.name: library_root
params.description: Root directory of the photo library

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "library.db"


@function_tool
def organize_photo_into_dated_folder(photo_id: int, library_root: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT file_path, captured_at FROM photos WHERE id = ?", (photo_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return f"Photo {photo_id} not found"
    current_path = Path(row[0])
    captured_at = row[1]
    year = captured_at[0:4]
    month = captured_at[5:7]
    target_dir = Path(library_root) / year / month
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    new_path = target_dir / current_path.name
    shutil.move(str(current_path), str(new_path))
    conn.execute("UPDATE photos SET file_path = ? WHERE id = ?", (str(new_path), photo_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"Moved photo {photo_id} to {new_path}"
